sources.title: executorch/examples/models/lfm2 at main · pytorch/executorch
sources.snippet: LFM2 is a new generation of hybrid models developed by Liquid AI and available in 3 variants - 350M, 700M, 1.2B. LFM2.5 is an updated version with improved training (28T tokens vs 10T) and extended context length support (32K tokens).

sources.title: LFM2-350M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: LFM2-350M is Liquid AI's smallest text model, designed for edge devices with strict memory and compute constraints. Delivers surprisingly strong performance for its size, making it ideal for low-latency applications.

sources.title: LFM2-350M: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview LFM2-350M is a 354.5M-parameter hybrid language model developed by LiquidAI specifically for edge AI and on-device deployment on smartphones, laptops, and vehicles. The model combines 10 double-gated short-range LIV convolution blocks with 6 grouped query attention blocks, achieving 3x faster training than its predecessor and 2x faster decode and prefill speed on CPU compared to Qwen3 ...
